notes: Counting: claims_audited counts distinct assertions (relevance sentences, concept sub-claims, table cells, pattern signal/diagnosis/follow-up, When-to-Use bullets, worked-example steps, anti-pattern fields, integration bullets, integrity-note items); faithful = claims_audited - findings; a finding that covers several sub-claims on one line counts once. Every quoted span was compared mechanically against the deep ref and the converted source (curly/straight quotes normalised), then mismatches read by hand. All [V] quotes are present in the deep ref and match the source except D010, D021, D028 (truncations). Unmarked verbatim quotes: lines 26, 34, 40, 130, 170, 185, 205. Hypothetical questions and scripts in quotation marks (lines 12, 30, 69, 91, 98, 112, 191 etc.) were read as the distillation's own wording and not graded. The 'at least 20 seconds' prescription (line 112) checks out at source line 2589. Converted source consulted for Introduction, Ownership, Choosing Space, Aesthetics, Storyboard, Nothing About Me, Unusual Suspects, Wise Crowds, Participatory Scenarios, 5 Whys, Speed Networking, 1-2-4, DAD, TRIZ, Wicked Questions, 15% Solutions, Troika, Agreement/Uncertainty, 25-to-10, After Action Debrief, Mini Constellations, Take 20 Seconds. Other deep refs checked for integration claims: letaw-handbook-sweng-methods-deep (RACI, triple constraint, fist-of-five, Tuckman), jones-evidence-based-sweng-deep (bi-exponential, post-1980, agency, cognitive capitalism: all confirmed), scrum-guide-2020-deep (container, Topic One, under-prescription: confirmed), open-practice-library-deep (1-2-4-All, Disagree and Commit, phases; no Wise Crowds/Troika/LS), openstax-principles-management-deep (Mintzberg roles, Five Forces, PESTEL), openstax-accounting-vol2-deep (TOC, CVP, break-even, relevant cost chapters), openstax-business-ethics-deep (Donaldson-Preston; no Mitchell-Agle-Wood), nhs-just-culture-guide-deep, tc-25-20-army-aar-deep, lfuo-learning-review-guide-2024-deep (administrative firewall, line 67: confirmed), approach-perfect-field-guide-scrum-events-deep (Prime Directive: confirmed).
